name: find_documents
description:
分页检索当前可用文档资产：产教政策、产业报告、行业报告、专业简介、人才需求调研、人才培养方案和教学案例等。

resource_type/domain(s) 限定业务类型；支持标题、主题、专业/院校/层次、区域、行业及来源发布日期组合过滤。
专业布点、市场岗位、职业分类大典等独立记录使用各自专用 API，不通过此文档目录查询。

`domain` is the official governance classification. `tags` is a repeated
semantic-query parameter; tags_match=any (default) takes the union and
tags_match=all takes the intersection of matched references. Set
`is_exact_matched=true` to compare normalized tag values exactly instead.
`tag_type` is optional: without it, each tag searches every controlled tag
type. Results do not contain a presigned URL; use each item's stable
`download_url_endpoint` to mint one on demand.

published_from.description: Inclusive source publication date; requires a full ISO date.
published_from.title: Published From

published_to.description: Inclusive source publication date; unknown/partial dates are excluded.
published_to.title: Published To

name: get_available_asset
description:
Asset detail filtered to `available` versions only.

404 if the asset has no `available` version, regardless of whether it exists
in other states (the upstream contract is "exists for consumption").

name: list_available_asset_versions
description: 读取指定资产中 available 版本的列表，不公开 processing、review_required、archived、disabled 或 failed 版本。

name: find_textbooks
description: 分页检索课程教材，支持教材名、理论/实训类型、出版社、主编、出版年组合过滤。只读取当前 available 且正式分类为教材的文档，返回源锚点及已有知识/任务大纲能力；不触发构建。

name: get_textbook
description: 读取单个课程教材的书目信息、源文档锚点及已有知识/任务大纲类型。仅当前 available 且正式分类为教材的文档可消费，不触发大纲生成；不可用返回 404。

name: discover_data_resources
description: 发现资产中心 16 类可见资源及其公开接口、过滤参数、能力与数量。包含教育部同步专业布点及职业分类大典；数量仅代表已入库覆盖。

name: query_enterprises
description: 分页检索企业数据。q 匹配企业名称、经营范围或所属园区名称；business_scope 匹配经营范围，park_id 精确限定园区。返回企业与已有园区关联，不推断合作关系。

name: get_enterprise
description: 读取单个企业的名称、经营范围、真实所属园区及来源锚点，不推断合作关系。不存在返回 404。

name: resolve_business_entities
description: Return stored name/code candidates with exact or substring match evidence. Ambiguous candidates are never merged.

name: get_evidence_bundle
description: Batch read-only resolution. Every item is independently checked; hidden and unknown IDs both return not_found.

name: search_firecrawl
description: External search can ingest data when auto_ingest=true. This consumption tool defaults auto_ingest=false; the executor MUST inject false if omitted. Discover, quality-check, and queue qualifying Firecrawl documents.

auto_ingest.title: Auto Ingest
auto_ingest.description: Queue qualifying results into the NEXUS crawler pipeline.

name: search_web_search
description:
External search can ingest data when auto_ingest=true. This consumption tool defaults auto_ingest=false; the executor MUST inject false if omitted. 使用 DeepSeek Search 联网搜索，返回带来源链接的正文结果，支持结果数量及日期范围。

服务端请求 need_content=true；query 最长 90 字符，日期预设会转换为 UTC 起止日期。
凭证由服务器配置，未配置或上游失败返回 503，不切换其他供应商。
auto_ingest=true 时，经 URL/正文质量及正式文件 authority>=3 检查后排队进入文档管道；
rerank_score 仅作诊断。auto_ingest=false 时只返回临时搜索结果，不入库。

query.title: Query
query.description: DeepSeek 搜索词，最多 90 字符；服务端追加日期条件，不发送内部检索材料。

auto_ingest.title: Auto Ingest
auto_ingest.description: Queue qualifying results into the NEXUS crawler pipeline.

time_range.title: Time Range
time_range.description: UTC 日期范围：OneDay/OneWeek/OneMonth/OneYear（分别近 1/7/30/365 天）或 YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD；起始日期不得晚于结束日期。

name: query_industrial_parks
description: 分页检索产业园区。q 匹配园区名称或介绍，industry 匹配行业标签，条件按 AND 组合。返回园区介绍、行业标签、真实关联企业数及来源；仅代表已入库覆盖。

name: get_industrial_park
description: 读取单个产业园区及数据库真实关联企业数量。通过 query_enterprises 的 park_id 可分页读取园区企业；不推断合作关系。不存在返回 404。

name: get_public_knowledge_chunk
description:
Return a single knowledge chunk for citation lookup.

Returns 404 if the chunk's anchoring asset version is not `available` —
upstream apps must not be able to dereference chunks belonging to
review_required / archived / disabled material.

name: aggregate_major_courses
description:
按省份汇总已入库、可用文档投影的院校课程覆盖。相同院校/专业/层次/省份优先采用培养方案，兼容已有专业简介课程行。

返回课程、院校数、院校专业数、样本院校数及覆盖率；未解析省份的来源单独计数。
仅代表已入库文档样本，不是教育部专业布点登记数据，也不代表全国课程覆盖。

name: list_major_offerings
description:
查询教育部政务服务平台同步及控制台 Excel 导入的专业布点数据，支持年份、省份、专业和学校组合过滤与分页。

返回省份、专业代码/名称、学校标识（可空）、学校名称、修业年限、备注及来源信息。
同一年份、同一学校、同一专业去重；同步直接入库，无 AI 治理或资产版本准入。
sync_run_id 和 import_id 分别标识 API 同步和 Excel 导入来源，二者仅有一个非空。
仅表示已入库覆盖，不代表全国总体，不读取已废弃的专业布点 Pipeline B 投影。

name: get_available_normalized_ref
description: Return a normalized_asset_ref only when its anchoring version is `available`.

name: list_chunks_for_normalized_ref
description:
Paginated chunks anchored on a normalized_ref.

Returns 404 when the ref does not exist or its anchoring version is not
`available` — same gate as `/knowledge-chunks/{chunk_id}`. Each chunk
carries `locator`, `source_block_ids`, and (when present) the
graph_extract `primary_block_ids` / `evidence_block_ids` at the top
level, so the Asset Detail consumer can render lineage without a second
round-trip to chunk_metadata.

name: get_normalized_ref_content
description:
Read the normalized payload from object storage and surface
``body_markdown`` + ``blocks`` (document type) or ``record_body``
(record type) for the Asset Detail "原文预览" tab.

The markdown stream is returned **byte-identical** to what was
persisted in MinIO — see ARCHITECT "Chunk Locator Contract" and
`mineru_converter._FORBIDDEN_ANCHOR_PATTERNS`. The frontend is
contracted to render block-level DOM anchors from ``blocks[].md_char_range``
without ever mutating the markdown text.

name: get_public_governance_result_for_ref
description:
Latest governance result for a normalized_asset_ref, forced to `view=public`.

`decision_trail`, AI suggestions, and confidence values are redacted to
classification/level/tags/quality_summary only — see
`nexus_app.governance.redaction.redact_governance_result(..., view='public')`.

name: read_existing_graph
description: Read an existing exact-ref graph or bounded neighborhood. Generated relations remain derived assertions with evidence.

name: get_knowledge_outline
description: Read only the existing knowledge outline; a missing outline never triggers a build.

name: get_outline_node_context
description: Read linked chunks in a node subtree, bounded by both chunk count and total text characters.

name: list_document_sections
description: List persisted block anchors, with bounded previews and an explicit continuation offset.

name: read_document_section
description: Read an anchored block and optional neighbors. Offsets count Unicode characters in the joined source text.

name: get_task_outline
description: Read only the existing task outline, separately from the knowledge hierarchy.

name: query_occupation_dictionary
description:
查询职业分类大典（2022 年版）基础表，按职业大类、小类、名称组合过滤（AND），支持分页。

返回职业编码、职业类别、职业大类、职业小类、职业名称、职业定义和工作任务。
数据来自本地名录及大典 PDF 核验补齐，仅表示已导入条目覆盖；不经过 AI 治理，
不依赖资产版本或 normalized_ref，不提供编辑、删除或自动生成内容。

name: get_raw_object_download_url
description:
Mint a short-lived presigned download URL for the raw object.

Gate: the raw_object must back at least one `available` asset version.
MinIO credentials live exclusively in nexus-app; this endpoint is the
sole choke-point. Default TTL 15 min (clamped 60s–1h).

name: list_ability_analyses
description:
Paginated list of `occupational_ability_analysis` rows.

Filters are AND-combined; missing filters mean "no filter". Sort:
`created_at DESC` so the latest analysis surfaces first — matches the
console's default browse order.

major_name.description: 专业名称过滤，走 ILIKE substring 匹配（自 v2.0.1 起从 exact 升级为 substring，配合 §1.13 归一化的 build.major_name 命中父子专业）
major_name.title: Major Name

name: get_ability_analysis
description: 读取职业能力分析及其分析模板。职业能力分析为独立领域记录，返回源分析与模板信息，不触发 AI 分析；不存在返回 404。

name: list_ability_items
description:
Paginated ability items for an analysis with optional filters.

`task_code` / `work_content_code` filter by the human-readable code
(not UUID) because that's what upstream consumers see in the rendered
tree. We resolve them to FK ids server-side.

category.description: Filter by ability_major_category_code (P / G / S / D ...)
category.title: Category

name: list_ability_relations
description: 分页读取指定职业能力分析中已存储的关系，支持 source_type、relation_type 过滤，不推断或新建关系；分析不存在返回 404。

name: get_ability_analysis_tasks
description:
Return the full task tree (tasks → work_contents) for one analysis.

Always returned in `display_order` ascending so consumers can render
without resorting. work_contents are batch-loaded by task_id to avoid
an N+1 query, which matters when the analysis carries 20+ tasks (e.g.
sample 2 has 4 tasks but a larger import may carry many more).

name: find_ability_items
description: Search stored ability items across analyses, preserving source analysis/ref and independent record boundaries.

name: get_job_capability_graph
description: Merge generated job-demand subgraphs matching a position title.

name: get_occupational_capability_graph
description: 按专业名称或代码读取最新已生成的职业能力分析图谱。只消费已有节点与关系，不触发构建；专业无已生成图谱时返回 404。

name: get_teaching_standard_knowledge_graph
description: 按专业名称或代码读取最新已生成的专业教学标准知识图谱。只消费已有节点与关系，不触发构建；无已生成图谱时返回 404。

name: search_evidence
description:
Search indexed knowledge chunks via pgvector.

Args:
    q: Search query (1–1024 chars)
    kb: Knowledge type code (e.g. 'course_textbook'). If omitted, the
        canonical course-textbook KB is used. `textbook_kb` remains an
        explicit legacy compatibility value only.
    top_k: Max results, 1–100 (DoS guard against unbounded fan-out)
    similarity_threshold: Minimum similarity score, 0.0–1.0
    outline_node: Optional knowledge_outline_node_id — filters hits to
        chunks under that node's subtree. 404 if the node does not exist.

outline_node.description: Restrict hits to chunks under this knowledge_outline_node's subtree (theory_knowledge textbook chapter/section filter).
outline_node.title: Outline Node

task_outline_node.description: Restrict retrieval to the existing task-outline node subtree; AND-combined with all other scopes.
task_outline_node.title: Task Outline Node

name: list_open_talent_training_plans
description: 分页检索人才培养方案，支持院校、专业、教育层次、修业年限、岗位、技能、证书、课程和来源发布日期组合过滤。仅公开当前 available 且正式分类为培养方案的文档投影；日期不使用入库时间替代。

name: get_open_talent_training_plan
description: 读取单个人才培养方案详情与课程声明。须由当前 available 且正式分类为培养方案的文档支撑；不可用返回 404，不触发抽取或治理。

name: get_open_course_knowledge_graph
description: 读取当前可用人才培养方案中课程和已有知识要求的关系视图；不是标准课程库，不触发新图谱生成。不可用返回 404。

name: get_open_position_capability_graph
description: 读取当前可用人才培养方案中岗位和已有能力要求的关系视图；不将其作为市场招聘统计，不触发新图谱生成。不可用返回 404。

name: list_training_plan_courses
description: Page through courses declared in an available training plan. They are plan-local declarations, not standard courses.

name: query_standard_courses
description: Query standard courses and their evidence. Hours are suggested; knowledge/skill/tool/literacy tags are derived.

name: get_standard_course
description: 读取标准课程及所属专业教学标准、建议学时、派生知识/技能/工具/素养标签和证据。所属标准须 active 且来源文档当前可用；不触发生成，不可用返回 404。

name: query_teaching_standards
description: Read active standards backed by current available documents; no activation side effect.

name: get_teaching_standard
description: 读取单个已激活专业教学标准及课程数量、专业身份和来源锚点。来源须为当前 available 且正式分类为教学标准的文档；不触发激活或图谱生成，不可用返回 404。
